coverage: San Francisco mainland and Treasure Island / Yerba Buena Island
license_note: Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License (PDDL 1.0) as published by DataSF.
notes: Based on the San Francisco Elevation Datum.
Current dataset exposes ELEVATION as numeric field and the_geom as line geometry.
Legacy DataSF identifier rnbg-2qxw is retained only as historical provenance; EarthForge acquisition uses current dataset 6d73-6c4f.
EarthForge fetches only a local bounding-box slice around the selected Lombard centerline.
